# Decode SQL fixture bytes with a fixed encoding before database creation

The address-book fixture generator opens the SQL input in binary mode and decodes it, using Python UTF-8 by default rather than the host text-file encoding. GeneratedFile connects that SQL input and script to import.sqlite. Preserve this portable decoding boundary for nearby fixtures with Unicode text. No generated database or platform encoding test was run here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Address-book fixture input encoding.
